from example.Employee import Employee


class Admin(Employee):
    def __init__(self, aName, aAge, aId, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        super().__init__(aName, aAge, aId)

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def delete(self):
        super().delete()

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
